definition: Fragility means the state of being easily broken or damaged, the quality of a delicate object or structure that must be handled with care.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word fragility. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know fragility should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The museum shipped the ancient glass vases in custom foam crates because of their extreme fragility.
Delicacy suggests something fine that calls for gentle handling, while fragility means the object can actually break or be damaged with very little force.
Fragility means something is easily damaged, but brittleness means it is so rigid that it shatters or snaps the instant it is bent or struck.

Flimsiness is weakness that comes from thin, insubstantial construction: a flimsy shelf was never sturdy to begin with. Fragility can belong to something finely and solidly made, like antique glass, that simply cannot survive rough handling. Flimsiness blames the build; fragility describes how easily damage happens.

Frailty is the bodily weakness of a living person, especially someone elderly or ill. Fragility belongs to objects and structures: glass, old paper, thin ice, things that break or crumble under small forces. You would speak of a patient's frailty but a vase's fragility.

The Linden County archive holds ninety years of the town's only newspaper, and almost no one is allowed to touch it.
Even the finest paper of that era was acidic, and it has spent decades quietly destroying itself; the fragility of those pages is now the archive's central problem.
Turn a 1943 issue carelessly and the corner snaps off like a potato chip.
Staff use foam cradles, felt weights, and a rule of one page per minute.
This year the county funded a scanner with a curved glass bed built for bound volumes, and two archivists began the slow work of digitizing.
The paper itself will keep crumbling — nothing can stop the chemistry — but by the time it goes, every page will exist somewhere that cannot break.
